scope: Optional confirmed-outcome bridge and private real-rule lab. No live hook, storage key, save schema or physical reward registration is installed.

checks.label: Durable queue, identity, pause and safe restoration
Actual paid receipt and departure evidence grammar
Private real-rule financial and lifecycle conservation
Offline real-rule lab import and asset boundaries
Premium UI, real operation flows and reduced motion
Overlay freshness, consumer direction and scope

domains.label: Confirmed rule-result adapters
invariants: A payment receipt is not admission, an animation or a completed visit. Preserve source/guest identity and original stamps.
Capture paid manifest route and queue wait at the real departure. No disappearance-based final-departure detector.

domains.label: Durable bounded host outbox
invariants: Queue acceptance does not charge again. Full queues retain the normalized retry fact; a producer must handle backpressure.
Pause retains confirmed facts; end requires delivery or literal true to discard. Preserve unsupported schemas and monotonic serials.

domains.label: Private real-rule service venue
invariants: Prepared funding, stock, Court guests and nominated ride demand are explicit test inputs, not a player-time/profit forecast.
Actual stock, guest spending and income reconcile. Snapshots are detached; restore preserves pending outcomes without inventing paid facts.
Action quotes run on a detached copy, including mutating food holds and planned ride visit IDs. A quote is never a committed sale.

domains.label: Premium receipt desk and causal motion
invariants: A receipt/stamp animates only after a new committed operation, never on replay or delivery. Real numeric values remain immediate.
Embed fonts/art, preserve keyboard/touch layouts, cancel one-shots for reduced motion and hidden pages. Do not boot live main/scene/storage.
Completed evenings retain earned3/3 summary without fabricated per-goal progress; repeats show fresh actual goals. Collapse inspectors and surface goals/results near touch actions.

domains.label: Bridge impact review and contractor handover
invariants: Pin the base matrix and reject a stale overlay; unknown changed paths require review, not a safe label.
Current-scope tests stay separate from conditional live hook/schema/inventory integration. Never execute suggested commands automatically.

edges.consequence: Food receipt identity, quantity and paid amount are an adapter contract.
Only actually paid order lines count; snacks and drinks remain distinct.
A successful pick supplies real yield/overflow; delivery or pantry stock is not harvest proof.
Paid manifests, run identity, source phase, route and waiting evidence determine completion facts.
Paid maze completion must be captured before repeat visit IDs change.
Court cohort flags and visitor/customer namespaces affect distinct guest credit.
Engine transitions and normalized reason/schema contracts drive queue delivery.
The private venue uses actual current level/equipment/service readiness.
Clean, detached facts are the only accepted outbox payload.
Private source operations must normalize actual results, not fabricate service outcomes.
Deferred delivery, replay and snapshot behavior determine whether paid facts remain durable.
The lab uses real saveData/restoreState and must deep-copy shallow serializer results.
Committed ledger, wallets, stock and operation results drive the receipt view and motion.
Queue and progress are separate UI states; held facts cannot look delivered.
The existing generated icon atlas and embedded fonts affect UI sizing/readability.
A stale dependency assessment may miss a producer contract change.
A stale dependency assessment may miss persistence/identity consequences.
Viewport, motion, fonts and offline build checks are selected before release.
Only when wiring live hooks: insert after confirmed debits, never pay twice or consume short receipt history as a full ledger.
Only when adopted: add explicit host state/migration and persist origins on ongoing saved attraction visits.
Only when physical rewards are registered: commit ownership and the stable claim key atomically or idempotently.
Only when adopting UI in-game: connect focus/controller/menu selectors and preserve the playfield.
Read-only dish previews must reproduce the real nominated guest quantity/price/stock without reserving real holds.
Cocoa previews must follow actual stock, changing guest IDs and current paid order pricing; quotes are not receipts.
The garden action describes current crop phase without promising a fabricated yield or income.
Ride fare/route previews use detached planning and must not allocate real visit IDs or promise a simulated trip duration.
Derived completion/claimed/repeat states follow the real view. An inactive completed evening must not display a false0/3 reset.
